scope: Preserved real development failures; none are counted as valid FPGA outputs or board tests

failures.cause: Vivado HLS 2017.4 generated date-derived Revision 2610120205 overflows a signed integer in packaging
failures.resolution: Reuse A2 workaround: only generated Revision metadata changed to 1. Original Tcl, exact diff and successful ip_packaging_fixed_02.log retained. Compiler/vendor library/RTL untouched.
failures.csim_scope: The 12-frame 1376256-word C simulation in this log passed before export failure; export did not pass

failures.cause: Relative preparatory paths were used in IP working directory rather than repository root; patched source was not found
failures.resolution: Ran preparatory script in repository root, then packaging in the actual IP directory; successful console_02/fixed_02 logs preserved

failures.cause: Old XSim did not resolve dynamic task string file names; vectors were not read. An apparent first-frame PASS could compare unknown values, and the second frame failed.
failures.resolution: Use fixed literal file names, initialize arrays to unknown and require all input/golden words to be known. Entire simulation rerun in a new directory; 13 complete cases and 1441792 known output words passed in axis_simulation_attempt_02.log.
failures.withdrawn: All PASS markers from attempt_01 are invalid and are excluded from coverage

failures.stage: First and second host runner regression
failures.cause: Host Python environment has no IPython display module; first stub fix did not span the repeated-call assertion
failures.resolution: Stub only display in the host test for all relevant calls. Real board program still uses IPython. Seven A3 tests passed in host_runner_tests_03.log; full suite passed 58 tests in host_runner_tests_final.log. Mocked data never constitute board evidence.
